directions: fixed high/low; random seed 4729; homogeneous constraints for extra directions; no per-h normalization
model_branch: original Canali cutoff 100 V/m in both value and derivative; no smoothing
resolution: paired full-reference differences estimate representation contribution; Richardson 4/3 norm(FD(h)-FD(h/2)) estimates coarse-h truncation only in smooth regime; not certified upper bounds; 3 consecutive anchor points needed; no event flips; unresolved rows separate
scope: actual complete residual with same non-mobility paths; these remain mixed precision and are not claimed fully high precision
update_gate: only isolated diagnostic updates until actual direction gates pass; unchanged production acceptance
factorial_reference: coefficient_only is common baseline for four single-stage arms; ordinary baseline retained separately
